# mongoid

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Mongoid is an ODM (Object Document Mapper) Framework for MongoDB, written in Ruby.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mongoid.org/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mongodb/mongoid
- 文档: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/
- 更新日志: https://github.com/mongodb/mongoid/releases
- 问题追踪: https://jira.mongodb.org/projects/MONGOID
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/mongoid
